'''karrde Melting is Profitable''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[karrde]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Profit karrde LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

my first profit deck shows the beauty of hit and run

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

There are plenty of ways to release Han.  Use whichever is easiest against the opponent u r playing.  Once Han is released, spread your forces out to make your opponent lose the maximum 5 from the objective.

Use order to engage to force him to attack, then fallen portal and narrow escape to show him the true art of hit and run.  If your opponent forces a major battle, repeating weapons w/nifty helping interrupts(not to mention crack shot!) plus destiny adders hurts him bad.  Against space, put gen. lando in falcon, otherwise use him w/vibro ax.

Card selections: old ben-keeps people alive

Electrobinocs-w/force can set up battle or weapon destiny

Traffic control-recycles unneeded high destiny cards

Uh-oh and the camp-add to his deployment on tattooine

Revisions I will make as soon as I get the cards: home 1, either luke w/lightsaber or master luke, leia rebel princess, and maybe naboo weapons
